Run a focused Playwright retest for contact form submission success toast and mobile horizontal overflow once trust copy check is stabilized.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL only from environment during pytest; CI/dev shells without exported variable will fail collection unless env is sourced first.
No backend delete endpoint exists for inquiries, so TEST_ inquiry data created during testing cannot be cleaned automatically.
seed_data_creation: Created inquiry via API with name prefix TEST_SERFIX_ for persistence validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite passed (3/3). Frontend checks passed for page load, desktop overflow, nav hash scrolling, tel/mailto CTA links, and services visibility. Playwright failed 3 times on trust text assertion path; per loop prevention, stopped further script rewrites. Continue with focused form-submit + mobile overflow checks.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open trust section and inspect [data-testid='trust-kicker']; Playwright text assertion for 'Local | Reliable | Trusted' failed consistently although layout loaded correctly. Potential cause: rendered glyph mismatch/normalization under font rendering (pipe appears as uppercase I visually). Mitigation: compare normalized characters in test and verify actual DOM textContent in runtime before strict assertion.
